learning_outcomes.text: Write, execute, and verify Python programs.
Understand the fundamental concepts of procedural programming.
Use the main control structures and fundamental data structures (lists, dictionaries, sets, tuples).
Read and write data to/from files.
Use scientific libraries for managing and processing numerical and graphical data (numpy, matplotlib, pandas).
Understand the basic principles of object-oriented programming.
Apply the learned concepts to solve simple practical problems of a technical-scientific and engineering nature.

syllabus_topics: Environments and tools for program development.
Functions for input acquisition and screen printing.
Standard Python libraries (math, random, time, etc.).
Elementary algorithms that operate on lists.
Creation and manipulation of tuples (immutable lists).
Introduction to pandas for managing simple tabular data.
Basic concepts: class, object, attributes, methods.
Simple examples of OOP modeling in the mechanical field.
Introduction to numpy for vectors and matrices.
Use of matplotlib for data visualization and graphs.
Notes on scipy for engineering applications (interpolation, fitting, numerical methods).
assessment_rules: The exam includes a theoretical test to evaluate understanding of programming concepts, and a practical programming test where students must apply acquired knowledge.
